description:
The same tool as r3_component_set (this is its older name): change properties of a component, kept at once in the project's live copy: every R3 tab with the project open shows it now, no editor needed and nothing to save.

Name the component with componentId or entityRef. `values` take r3_component_set's shapes: a plain value {"roughness": 0.25}; a value component as an object of the keys to change {"position": {"y": 2}} (an EMPTY slot, e.g. a rigid body's centerOfMass, is made from the fields given: {"centerOfMass": {"z": -0.3, "mass": 8}}); a reference as the target's entityRef {"material": "material_cube_1"} (null clears it); a list of references as an array of entityRefs (it REPLACES the list). All-or-nothing: an unknown name is refused with the valid ones. A Code component's code is r3_editor_code's.
name: r3_editor_set

answer.description: This answer in words: what was done, what R3 measured, decided or refused, and what to do next. The same text as the result's text block. Read it: the fields beside it are the data, this is the guidance.

title: Change a property LIVE in the user's open R3 editor
